verses.en: O Israel, return unto the LORD thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.
verses.pt: Volta, ó Israel, para o Senhor teu Deus; porque pela tua iniqüidade tens caído.
verses.en_web: Israel, return to Yahweh your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.
verses.en_bbe: O Israel, come back to the Lord your God; for your evil-doing has been the cause of your fall.

verses.en: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.
verses.pt: Tomai convosco palavras, e voltai para o Senhor; dizei-lhe: Tira toda a iniqüidade, e aceita o que é bom; e ofereceremos como novilhos os sacrifícios dos nossos lábios.
verses.en_web: Take words with you, and return to Yahweh. Tell him, “Forgive all our sins, and accept that which is good: so we offer our lips like bulls.
verses.en_bbe: Take with you words, and come back to the Lord; say to him, Let there be forgiveness for all wrongdoing, so that we may take what is good, and give in payment the fruit of our lips.

verses.en: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.
verses.pt: Não nos salvará a Assíria, não iremos montados em cavalos; e à obra das nossas mãos já não diremos: Tu és o nosso Deus; porque em ti o órfão acha a misericórdia.
verses.en_web: Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for in you the fatherless finds mercy.”
verses.en_bbe: Assyria will not be our salvation; we will not go on horses; we will not again say to the work of our hands, You are our gods; for in you there is mercy for the child who has no father.

verses.en: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
verses.pt: Eu sararei a sua apostasia, eu voluntariamente os amarei; porque a minha ira se apartou deles.
verses.en_web: “I will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away from him.
verses.en_bbe: I will put right their errors; freely will my love be given to them, for my wrath is turned away from him.

verses.en: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
verses.pt: Eu serei para Israel como o orvalho; ele florescerá como o lírio, e lançará as suas raízes como o Líbano.
verses.en_web: I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.
verses.en_bbe: I will be as the dew to Israel; he will put out flowers like a lily, and send out his roots like Lebanon.

verses.en: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
verses.pt: Estender-se-ão as suas vergônteas, e a sua formosura será como a da oliveira, a sua fragrância como a do Líbano.
verses.en_web: His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.
verses.en_bbe: His branches will be stretched out, he will be beautiful as the olive-tree and sweet-smelling as Lebanon.

verses.en: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
verses.pt: Voltarão os que habitam à sua sombra; reverdecerão como o trigo, e florescerão como a vide; o seu renome será como o do vinho do Líbano.
verses.en_web: Men will dwell in his shade. They will revive like the grain, and blossom like the vine. Their fragrance will be like the wine of Lebanon.
verses.en_bbe: They will come back and have rest in his shade; their life will be made new like the grain, and they will put out flowers like the vine; his name will be like the wine of Lebanon.

verses.en: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.
verses.pt: ç Efraim, que tenho eu com os ídolos? Sou eu que respondo, e cuido de ti. Eu sou como a faia verde; de mim é achado o teu fruto.
verses.en_web: Ephraim, what have I to do any more with idols? I answer, and will take care of him. I am like a green cypress tree; from me your fruit is found.”
verses.en_bbe: As for Ephraim, what has he to do with false gods any longer? I have given an answer and I will keep watch over him; I am like a branching fir-tree, from me comes your fruit.

verses.en: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the LORD are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.
verses.pt: Quem é sábio, para que entenda estas coisas? prudente, para que as saiba? porque os caminhos do Senhor são retos, e os justos andarão neles; mas os transgressores neles cairão.
verses.en_web: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of Yahweh are right, and the righteous walk in them; But the rebellious stumble in them.
verses.en_bbe: He who is wise will see these things; he who has good sense will have knowledge of them. For the ways of the Lord are straight, and the upright will go in them, but sinners will be falling in them.
